configure.title: Configure Vehicle OBD BLE
configure.description: Select a vehicle profile and configure BLE GATT UUIDs if your adapter uses non-standard characteristics.

data_description.profile: Use generic standard OBD-II, a tested vehicle-family profile, or custom PIDs from overrides.yaml.
data_description.service_uuid: GATT service UUID used to connect to the OBD BLE dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_read: GATT characteristic UUID for receiving data from the dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_write: GATT characteristic UUID for sending commands to the dongle.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Settings to control the behaviour of this interface

data_description.profile: Vehicle profile determining which OBD-II / UDS diagnostic commands are sent.
data_description.cache_values: Keep the last valid value when the vehicle sleeps or a polling cycle returns no data. The cache resets when Home Assistant restarts.
data_description.fast_poll: Polling rate to use when actively getting data from the car.
data_description.slow_poll: Polling rate to use when the car is in range, but turned off.
data_description.xs_poll: Polling rate to use when the car is out of range. Home Assistant will listen for bluetooth advertisements and update immediately if the car comes back into range.
data_description.service_uuid: GATT service UUID used to connect to the OBD BLE dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_read: GATT characteristic UUID for receiving data from the dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_write: GATT characteristic UUID for sending commands to the dongle.
